newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche BA says 96/97 revenue up 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche BA says 96/97 revenue up 5.7 pct.

text.p: Deutsche BA, which is 49 percent owned by British Airways Plc, said on Monday its revenue rose by 5.7 percent to 520 million marks in the business year to March 31, 1997 while passenger numbers rose 6.8 percent to 2.2 million.
The company said that by the end of this year its fleet will consist of 18 Boeing B737-300 jets which should reduce its maintenance and operational costs.
Deutsche BA said it had reached a market share of 35 percent on the seven German domestic routes it operates.
The airline plans to increase its revenue to 600 million marks in the current business year and raise its market share to 40 percent.
